title: Jiufen vs Shifen: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Jiufen for atmosphere, food, and depth. Shifen for the sky lantern bucket-list moment. Do both if you have a full day.

categories.name: Atmosphere & Experience
categories.summary: Jiufen has layered hillside alleys, tea houses with ocean views, and cinematic red lanterns. Shifen is smaller and more one-dimensional.

categories.name: Signature Activity
categories.summary: Shifen wins for the sky lantern launch. Jiufen wins for the sustained tea house experience.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Jiufen's taro balls, fish balls, and street food scene far outpaces Shifen's limited stalls.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Shifen is cheaper overall — NT$350-700 total vs NT$500-1,200 for Jiufen with tea house.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Bus 1062 makes Jiufen a single direct 1.5h ride from Taipei. Shifen requires a transfer.

categories.name: Crowds & Timing
categories.summary: Both get crowded, but Jiufen has escape routes in side alleys. Shifen has nowhere to hide.

categories.name: Photography
categories.summary: Jiufen offers more photogenic moments across the day. Shifen delivers one iconic lantern shot.

categories.name: Standalone Value
categories.summary: Jiufen is a full half-day destination. Shifen works best as an add-on.

faq.question: Is Jiufen or Shifen better for a day trip from Taipei?
faq.answer: Jiufen is the better standalone day trip. Add Shifen if you have a full day.

faq.question: Can you do both Jiufen and Shifen in one day?
faq.answer: Yes, do Shifen first (arrive 9am), taxi to Jiufen by 11am, stay for sunset.

faq.question: How much does a sky lantern cost in Shifen?
faq.answer: NT$150-500 depending on size. Four-panel writing lanterns run NT$350-500.
